name: San Joaquin Valley (Tulare basin), California (USA)

disp.description: LOS displacement, + toward satellite, relative to scene median

method: Per pair: unwrapped HH phase minus the product's ionospheric phase screen, converted to LOS displacement with -λ/4π (positive = toward the satellite). Samples with coherence < 0.3 or connected component 0 are dropped; per-cell median of 80 m samples (≥ 8). Each pair is referenced to its scene median, so values are relative motion within the area.
limitations: Single 12-day pairs are dominated by tropospheric noise (often ±1–2 cm); slow subsidence is clearer when pairs on one track are summed. Unwrapping errors can occur across low-coherence areas. Values are line-of-sight, not vertical.
